caption: Tongs reach into a bakery's glass counter from the open back and lift out a pastry that was visible through the glass.

sa.check: A pastry is visible through a bakery's glass counter.
The tongs enter from the open back.
The reach comes first and the lift follows.

pc.expect: The pastry is clearly visible through the glass and the tongs lift the one that was seen.
pc.fail: The glass hides the pastry; or a different pastry is lifted; or the pastry changes as it is lifted.

pc.expect: The tongs enter from behind rather than through the pane.
pc.fail: The tongs pass through the glass; or the pastry passes through the glass; or the glass passes through the tongs.

pc.expect: The pastry moves only in the tongs.
pc.fail: It rises by itself; or slides; or jumps.

pc.expect: The tongs are rigid and the pastry firm.
pc.fail: The tongs bend like rubber; or the pastry flows; or the glass ripples.

pc.expect: The pastries keep their number apart from the one lifted.
pc.fail: A pastry vanishes; or appears; or the lifted one duplicates.

pc.expect: The counter and the pastries stay the same.
pc.fail: The pastries change colour; or the counter changes; or the shop rearranges.

note: The hand is the minimal trigger; the person is not judged.
